title: RISKWISE Engine Manifest
description: Manifest describing a Python engine release payload consumed by the RISKWISE Electron app. Served as engine-manifest.json from the GitHub Release assets of the engine channel and signed with an offline key (minisign v0.9 / Ed25519). The detached signature lives next to the manifest as engine-manifest.json.minisig.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Bumped on breaking format changes so older clients can reject unknown layouts.

channel.description: Release channel this manifest was published on. Must match the channel the client is subscribed to; mismatches are rejected.

version.description: Engine version, independent of app version. SemVer with the same -beta.N / -internal.N suffix conventions used for app tags.

released_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the engine artifact was published. Used for display only; trust is derived from the signature, not the timestamp.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the engine archive at download_url. Verified after download; a mismatch deletes the partial file and retries from byte 0.

size_bytes.description: Expected size of the engine archive in bytes. Used to pre-allocate disk and drive the download progress bar.

download_url.description: HTTPS URL to the engine archive. Must support HTTP Range requests so TLS-inspection proxies that corrupt mid-download can resume from the last good byte.

min_app_version.description: Lowest app version compatible with this engine. An older app refuses to use the engine and prompts the user to update the app first.

max_app_version.description: Optional inverse binding. A newer app that needs engine features beyond this version must refuse to use the cached engine and trigger a re-download. Absent means no upper bound.

notes_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL to engine release notes (Markdown). Rendered inside the What's New dialog beneath the app release notes.
